title: Question
description: A single trivia question with its category, difficulty, and answers.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level assigned to the question.

category.description: Human-readable category name (HTML-entity encoded by default).

question.description: The trivia question prompt, encoded per the encode parameter.
question.example: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

correct_answer.description: The correct answer to the question.

incorrect_answers.description: One incorrect answer for boolean questions, or three for multiple-choice.
